PC: History Taking: Student takes complete and accurate history efficiently. Responds to patient's affect and non-verbal cues (EPA 1).
Clinical Evaluation and Management: Student demonstrates a well-reasoned, individualized use of tests and procedures, generating a comprehensive treatment plan (EPA 3).
MK: Interpret vital signs and lab results
Interpret physical findings and ultrasound results
Fund of Knowledge: Student applies understanding of pathophysiology to clinical context (EPA 2).
SBP: Systems Awareness: Student understands and uses hospital systems information to facilitate patient care (notifies OR, blood bank, anesthesia) (EPA 13).
ICS: Obtain informed consent (not included in clerkship level learners)
Perform handoff of patient to next provider
Interpersonal Skills: Student engenders trust, and uses communication skills to deliver high level of care.

Presentation Skills: Student uses SBAR to present a cogent, efficient and sophisticated hand off, synthesizing complex information, conveying thought processes behind clinical decisions, and tailored to the setting. (EPA 8).
Student obtains informed consent for D&C (EPA 11).
PBLI: Desire to Learn: Student demonstrates intellectual curiosity (EPA 7).
PROF: Professionalism: Student models highest standards of integrity, reliability and collegiality in interactions with team and patient, seeking out and accepting responsibility
